Indikator 1 measures the timeliness of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] initiation for newly diagnosed patients with [[atrieflimren]] who have a [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score of 2 or higher [^src2], [^src5]. The indicator tracks the proportion of these patients who begin oral anticoagulation within a window spanning 120 days before to 30 days after their primary diagnosis date [^src2], [^src5]. Patients with a score below 2, those without residency in [[danmark|Danmark]], and those who die within 30 days of the index date are excluded from the metric [^src2], [^src5].

In the 2023 reporting period, national data indicated that out of 10,010 patients, 52.6% started treatment within four months prior to diagnosis, while 47.4% started within 30 days after discharge [^src1]. Among the regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] had the highest proportion of pre-diagnosis treatment initiation (56.7%), whereas [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] had the lowest (47.1%) [^src1]. 

By the 2024 and 2025 reporting periods, the metric was standardized to evaluate performance against an [[udviklingsmaal-90-percent|Udviklingsmål ≥ 90%]] [^src3], [^src4]. Nationally, the proportion of patients receiving timely treatment improved from 91.1% in 2022/23 to 91.6% in 2023/24, and remained stable at 91.6% in the current period (July 2024 to June 2025) [^src3]. All five Danish regions successfully met the 90% target in the current period [^src3]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] led the regions with a 93.8% success rate, followed by [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (92.4%), [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (92.0%), [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (90.6%), and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (90.3%) [^src3].

At the health cluster level, performance varied significantly, with several clusters failing to meet the 90% target [^src3]. The highest-performing clusters were [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] (95.1%), [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] (95.0%), [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]] (94.5%), and [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] (94.4%) [^src3]. Conversely, the trailing clusters that missed the target included [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] (88.0%), [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] (88.9%), [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] (89.1%), [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] (89.2%), and [[sundhedsklynge-fyn|Sundhedsklynge Fyn]] (89.3%) [^src3].

Notable trends and outliers exist within specific clusters. [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] experienced a sharp decline, dropping from 96.3% in 2022/23 to 88.0% in the current period [^src3]. Similarly, [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] showed a downward trend, achieving 91.4% in the current year compared to 92.8% in the previous year and 96.1% the year prior [^src4]. In contrast, clusters like [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] demonstrated strong improvement, rising from 91.6% in 2022/23 to 95.1% in the current period [^src3].

Additional methodological context, historical trend analyses, and comprehensive regional breakdowns for this indicator are detailed across the broader sections of the annual reports [^src6], [^src7], [^src8], [^src9], [^src10], [^src11], [^src12], [^src13], [^src14], [^src15], [^src16], [^src17], [^src18], [^src19], [^src20], [^src21], [^src22], [^src23], [^src24], [^src25], [^src26], [^src27], [^src28], [^src29], [^src30], [^src31], [^src32], [^src33], [^src34], [^src35], [^src36], [^src37], [^src38], [^src39], [^src40], [^src41], [^src42], [^src43], [^src44], [^src45], [^src46], [^src47], [^src48].
